meta_title: Adem Plumbing & Heating | Central Heating Nottingham
meta_description: Adem Plumbing and Heating offer expert central heating, boiler installs and plumbing across Nottingham. Gas Safe registered, free quotes. Call today.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Free No-Obligation Quotes
hero_subhead: Boiler breakdowns and cold radiators can't wait — get a fast, honest fix from a local engineer you can trust.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Nottingham
services_subhead: From boiler installations and annual servicing to emergency repairs and full central heating upgrades, we cover every aspect of your home's heating and plumbing needs.

services.title: Boiler Installation
services.desc: We supply and fit energy-efficient boilers from leading brands, tailored to your home's size and hot-water demands. All installations are Gas Safe certified and fully commissioned on the day.

services.title: Boiler Servicing
services.desc: A thorough annual service keeps your boiler running safely and efficiently, reducing the risk of costly breakdowns. We check all components, clean the heat exchanger, and issue a full service report.

services.title: Boiler Repairs
services.desc: Whether it's a loss of pressure, a faulty pilot light, or a complete lockout, our engineer will diagnose and repair the fault promptly. We carry common spare parts to resolve most issues in a single visit.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Planning a new build or upgrading an ageing system? We design and install complete central heating systems, including pipework, radiators, and controls, built to last. All work is pressure-tested and Building Regulations compliant.

services.title: Radiator & Pipework Repairs
services.desc: Cold spots, leaking radiators, and noisy pipes are no match for our experienced team. We power-flush, re-balance, and repair your system so every room reaches the right temperature.

services.title: General Plumbing
services.desc: From dripping taps and leaking joints to full bathroom re-pipes, we handle all domestic plumbing work across Nottingham. No job is too small — we take the same care whatever the task.

about_pullquote: Every home deserves honest work done properly, first time.
about_para_1: Adem Plumbing and Heating was founded by a Gas Safe registered engineer with a passion for delivering reliable, fairly priced heating and plumbing services to homeowners across Nottingham and the surrounding areas. Based in Trowell, we've spent years building a reputation for quality craftsmanship and straight-talking advice.
about_para_2: We believe the best recommendations come from satisfied customers, so we never cut corners or oversell work you don't need. Our engineers arrive on time, keep your home clean and tidy, and explain everything in plain English — which is why so many of our customers come back year after year.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Adem came out the same day our boiler packed in during a cold snap. He had it diagnosed and fixed within the hour, and the price was completely fair. Brilliant service — I wouldn't use anyone else now.
reviews.author: Claire B.

reviews.text: Had a full central heating system installed by Adem and the team. They were tidy, professional, and finished on schedule. The whole house heats up so much faster now. Highly recommend for any heating work.
reviews.author: James R.

reviews.text: Really honest and knowledgeable. Came to service our boiler and spotted a small issue before it became a big problem. Explained everything clearly and didn't try to upsell anything unnecessary. Great local tradesman.
reviews.author: Sandra T.
